user_query: I'm a fashion blogger and I'm looking for some unique and trendy outfits to feature on my blog. Can you suggest some local boutiques and online stores that offer a wide range of stylish clothing options? It would be great if you could also provide information about ongoing fashion trends and popular fashion influencers.

TaskList.description: Search for local boutiques that offer trendy outfits.
Search for online stores that provide a wide range of stylish clothing options.
Gather information about ongoing fashion trends.
Compile a list of popular fashion influencers to follow.
